evidenceScope: Resource custody observation only; parent owns source and application test certification

wakeHelper.custodyAncestryScope: outside monitored launcher ancestry; status read from its own receipt

limitations: Read-only observation covers only the recorded interval for the exact current launcher; earlier attempts and resources outside that interval are excluded.
A fifteen-second delay between samples, plus collection time, may miss short-lived descendants or databases; this does not provide full runtime resource coverage.
Ownership is restricted to observed process identities rooted in the captured launcher identity and the disposable helper exact PID/random-suffix naming pattern.
Existing unrelated database names are never attributed, dropped or otherwise modified; no global-prefix cleanup claim is made.

Build checkout proof covers only exact explicit allocation messages from the fresh current-run stdout; short-lived unit workers may not appear in process samples, and unannounced or historical directories are excluded.
Process disappearance and zero observed retained resources are bounded observations, not forced-termination, power-loss or universal cleanup guarantees.
